title: Counting Animals
summary: All the animals in the jungle are very thirsty! Join them as they head to the lake for a drink.
pages: One elephant goes to drink some water.
Two giraffes are going to drink water.

Three bulls and four birds
want to drink the water too.

Five deer and six wild boars
head toward the water of the lake.
Seven zebras run toward the water.

Eight frogs and nine fish
swim in the cool water.

One lion roars.
He wants to drink too.
Which animals are afraid of the lion?

Only one elephant stays to drink
together with the lion.
